summary: Reuse isolated Chromium worker contexts for strict kit plays while retaining fresh pages, the complete viewport/theme matrix and strict lifecycle assertions.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No application or API change. Kit CI retains immutable HTTP resources across cases but clears cookies, permissions and observed-origin storage before every fresh page, audits residual state, and exercises real-browser isolation and broken-story negative controls. All stories, viewport/theme cases and existing strict assertions remain required.
